title: Hamac Optimised
description: this is a lighter version of Fabulously Optimised, it is less performant than Fabulously Optimised but also takes up less storage.
body:
# Hamac Optimised

This modpack is designed for computers without as much storage capacity. it contains sodium and a few other optimisation mods, but also a few utility mods like zoomify and fullbright.

## Comparison
A brand New verison of Fabulously Optimised takes up _~32MB_ of space.
And a brand New Installation of Hamac Optimised takes up _~23MB_ of storage space.
